REVENUE DELEGATION AUTHORITY ORDER NO. 0 19 = 2? 0 2 6

In view of the approved leave of TERESITA M. ANGELES, Deputy Commissioner (DCIR),
Resource Management Group (RMG), from May 5 to 29, 2026, and in order not to disrupt the
operations of the RMG, as the exigencies of the service so require, GEALDINA E. REYES,
Assistant Commissioner, Administrative Service, is hereby designated as Officer-in-Charge of
the Office of the DCIR-RMG, giving her the authority to sign all necessary documents
concerning the said Office.

This Order shall take effect on May 5, 2026, and shall automatically be revoked upon
the return of DCIR TERESITA M. ANGELES for official duty.

CHARLITO MARTIN R. MEND
Commissioner of Internal Revenue
